newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Malaysia's Sime Bank unit mandates $100 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Sime Bank unit mandates $100 mln FRCD.

text.p: Sime International Bank (L) Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Sime Bank Bhd, has mandated three banks to arrange a US$100 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue, bankers said on Monday.
The issue will be guaranteed by Sime Bank Bhd.
Sime Bank was known as United Malayan Banking Corp prior to its takeover by Sime Darby in 1996.
The certificates will carry a maturity of three years and the all-in return will be 26-28 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Bankers said the arrangers are Fuji International Finance (HK), Development Bank of Singapore and LTCB Asia.
General syndication will begin after the formation of a co-arranger group.
